title: Temporary forum-access workaround
summary: The searchlab.eu domain currently appears to have expired, so community.searchlab.eu is not reachable normally. The actual Discourse server is still online at: 167.235.1.187 I confirmed it responds correctly when the hostname/SNI is set to community.searchlab.eu, with HTTP 200 and a valid Let’s Encrypt certificate. Temporary Linux workaround: `sudo sh -c 'echo "167.235.1.187 community.searchlab.eu" >> /etc/hosts'` Then access: [https://community.searchlab.eu](https://community.searchlab.eu) **Important:** remove the override once the domain is renewed, because the forum IP may change. This is only a temporary workaround for the expired DNS/domain; the forum server itself appears to be running normally. `HTTP/1.1 200 OK Server: nginx X-Discourse-Route: list/latest subject: CN=community.searchlab.eu SSL certificate verify ok`
